message.text:
Beginning to enumerate distinct server surfaces that enforce memo visibility.

Memo read access checks in `memo_service.go`. List and filter queries apply visibility filters in `memo_service.go`, `user_service_stats.go`, `memo_relation_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`, and `memo_service_converter.go`. Attachment access checks in `attachment_service.go`. Fileserver permission checks in `fileserver.go`. RSS and frontend sitemap restrict memos to public-only in `rss.go` and `frontend.go`. SSE delivery checks in `sse_hub.go`. Email notification access checks in `notification/email.go`.

Notification API checks in `user_service_notifications.go`. Reaction checks in `reaction_service.go`. Mention helpers in `memo_mention_helpers.go`. The response will list six distinct server surfaces rather than individual helper functions.

Settled on six distinct enforcement sites. API checks, list filters, attachments, reactions, and notifications will be grouped into a single gRPC/Connect API surface. Fileserver, RSS, frontend sitemap, SSE, and email remain separate surfaces.

Finalized exact file paths for each enforcement site. API read checks and list filters are in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. Attachment checks are in `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`. Fileserver permissions are in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`. RSS and sitemap public-only listings are in `server/router/rss/rss.go` and `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`. SSE delivery checks are in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`. Email notification access checks are in `server/notification/email.go`. Notification API access checks are in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`.

h15.
API single-memo read (`checkMemoReadAccess`) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
API list/query filters (`VisibilityList` / CEL visibility) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go, user_service_stats.go, memo_relation_service.go, memo_service_comments.go
API attachment access — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go
HTTP fileserver attachment permission — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go
RSS public-only feeds — server/router/rss/rss.go
Frontend sitemap public-only listing — server/router/frontend/frontend.go
SSE delivery (`canReceive`) — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go
Email notifications (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — server/notification/email.go
Notification API (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go
